AUTHOR: Alessandro Manzoni
TITLE: I promessi sposi (The Betrothed)
PASSAGE: The opening description of Lake Como and the Lecco branch in Chapter I, including the view of the Resegone and the Spanish garrison/castle
CONFIDENCE: 97
EVIDENCE: The embargoed words (Como, Lecco, Resegone, giogaia, andirivieni, ciottoloni, valloncelli, "spagnoli") are the signature vocabulary of Manzoni's famous "Quel ramo del lago di Como" incipit; the long, heavily nested first period followed by shorter topographic periods and a final sentence on the Spanish soldiery matches that passage's structure.
